main_findings: The model produced valid JSON and no action items or open questions, which matches the conservative addon gold standard.
The model initially used cleaned or cross-speaker evidence; deterministic evidence repair reduced validation issues from 7 to 0 without another API call.
The model recalled durable/drop-resistant design, LED feedback, and appearance/compatibility-related requirements.
The model missed or under-specified original/trendy/user-friendly, price and manufacturing budget, fewer buttons, inexpensive material, and battery-saving requirements.
next_recommendation: Tune the addon Prompt to ask for early-stage goals, budget constraints, and late brainstorming design requirements as separate accepted design requirements before running another real call.
